data.cell_id_column: Cell id column shared by --input and --lineages. Defaults to the first column of each file.
data.lineage_id_column: Cell id column in the lineage table (defaults to cell_id_column / first column).
data.dim1_column: Embedding column for the first dimension. Defaults to the second column of --input.
data.dim2_column: Embedding column for the second dimension. Defaults to the third column of --input.
data.lineages: Lineage/pseudotime columns to plot from the lineage table. Defaults to all non-id columns.

plot_mode.dims: Integer vector c(1,2) selecting which dim indices to use from the embedding.
plot_mode.trim: Numeric vector c(lower, upper) quantiles used to trim lineage values before loess fitting.
plot_mode.return_layer: Return the layer list instead of a ggplot (for composition). Default FALSE.

labels.title: Plot title.
labels.subtitle: Plot subtitle.
labels.xlab: X axis title. Defaults to the dim1 column name.
labels.ylab: Y axis title. Defaults to the dim2 column name.

colors.palette: Named palette from SCA paletteCustomize (read from assets/palettes.rds). Default Dark2.
colors.palcolor: Named vector of explicit lineage colors, e.g. {"Lineage1": "#E64B35"}.
colors.line_bg: Background stroke color behind each curve. Default white.
colors.line_bg_stroke: Extra linewidth added to the background stroke. Default 0.5.

layers.whiskers: Draw whisker segments from fitted to raw points. Default FALSE.
layers.lineages_arrow: Add an arrow to the lineage paths. Default TRUE (arrow length 0.1 inches).

legends.legend_position: right, left, bottom, top, or none. Default right.

selectors.highlight_lineages: Lineages to emphasize (reserved for highlight styling).
